_comment: Placeholder route spec. The real one names real airports and lives only in
the FFS_ROUTES GitHub Actions secret -- never commit a filled-in copy.
nights = days from departure to return. day_offsets are applied to both ends,
so [-1, 0, 1] expands each base weekend into 9 date combinations.
min_nights drops trips shorter than this; the default of 1 excludes same-day round trips.
A route can set its own base_weekday (0-6, or a name like "Tuesday") to track a second trip shape, here a Tuesday-to-Wednesday fortnight beside the Friday-to-Sunday one.
combos_per_visit searches the base trip plus a rotating few of the other date combinations each visit.
every_days may not be a multiple of 7, or each window would always be checked on the same weekday.
